    How a project moves

    From drawings to fabricated material

    No runaround between separate glass and metal vendors — the conversation starts with your project, and the fabrication happens in Corona.

    STEP 01

    Tell us the project

    Share what you're building — drawings, dimensions, quantities, and the material you're picturing. The inquiry form below turns it into a clean summary you can send in one message.

    STEP 02

    Fabrication in Corona

    Glass is tempered or laminated, and metal is cut on the CNC laser — the three processes Apex runs in its Queens operation, coordinated as one order instead of three.

    STEP 03

    Built to your spec

    Material comes off the line made to the measurements you supplied — sized for the openings, rails, and panels your crew is installing, not cut down from stock on site.
